highlights: Automated Fact-Checking & Bias Elimination (Gemini 2.0 vs DeepSeek)

points: Architected an end-to-end Voice AI RAG agent (WebSockets, Deepgram Nova-3 STT, DeepSeek autonomous tool calling, Edge-TTS) cutting lookup latency by 65%; built a FastAPI + Gemini microservice integrated with Laravel/S3 for automated catalog visualization.

Designed an in-memory caching engine with TTL, prefix invalidation, and cache stampede protection (inflight request coalescing); eliminated database N+1 query bottlenecks via batched fetching, cutting peak API latency by up to 70%.

Engineered an automated transactional billing pipeline with PDFKit multi-item tax/discount calculations and integrated Meta WhatsApp Cloud API (v21.0) with dynamic templates for instantaneous invoice and document delivery upon payment.

Built a regulatory KYC onboarding engine integrating PowerAPI and Cashfree (Aadhaar OTP with masked PDF, PAN validation, Bank Penny-Drop); implemented cryptographically secure 6-digit OTP verification and enterprise RBAC.

Developed and maintained 20+ production RESTful APIs in Laravel for an e-commerce logistics platform, implementing Service Layer Architecture and Eloquent ORM to decouple controller business logic and improve maintainability.
Architected asynchronous background processing using Laravel Queues, Jobs, and Redis, scaling concurrent shipment ingestion capacity by 300% and eliminating HTTP request timeout bottlenecks.
Engineered custom WordPress and WooCommerce payment gateway integrations with Razorpay and Stripe, implementing webhook signature verification and idempotent order state transitions.

bio: Full-Stack & Backend Systems Engineer with 2.5+ years of experience building backend services, REST APIs, and GenAI microservices in Node.js/TypeScript, Laravel, Python, and React/Next.js.

Architected real-time Voice AI RAG agents over WebSockets (Deepgram Nova-3, DeepSeek, Edge-TTS) cutting lookup latency by 65%, an in-memory caching layer with cache stampede protection cutting peak API latency by up to 70%, and transactional pipelines with Meta WhatsApp Cloud API and fintech KYC integrations (Aadhaar/PAN/Penny-Drop).
Specialized in high-throughput API architecture, resolving database N+1 query bottlenecks, request coalescing, and building resilient distributed systems.
